serialize_python_object_to_tensor: serialize any Python object into a PyTorch ByteTensor using pickle for distributed communication
serialize_object_with_fixed_buffer: serialize a Python object to a fixed-size PyTorch tensor padded with zeros for fixed-width messaging
deserialize_tensor_to_python_object: deserialize a PyTorch tensor back into the original Python object using pickle
test_pyobject_to_tensor_roundtrip: test that pyobject_to_tensor and tensor_to_pyobject roundtrip a Python object correctly
review_tensor_serialization_for_distribu: review the pickle-based tensor serialization utilities for use in distributed PyTorch workflows
